Bowles brackets, edgewise brackets, multiphase brackets, ribbon arch brackets, twin-wire brackets, and universal brackets are all types of orthodontic brackets.

name: orthopedic nursing
query: Query: orthopedic nursing [SEP] Orthopedic nursing is the specialty or practice of nursing in the care of the orthopedic patient.

name: osteoblasts
query: Query: osteoblasts [SEP] Osteoblasts is bone-forming cells which secrete an extracellular matrix. hydroxyapatite crystals are then deposited into the matrix to form bone.

name: osteosarcoma
query: Query: osteosarcoma [SEP] Osteosarcoma is a sarcoma originating in bone-forming cells, affecting the ends of long bones. It is the most common and most malignant of sarcomas of the bones, and occurs chiefly among 10- to 25-year-old youths. (From Stedman, 25th ed)

name: outline
query: Query: outline [SEP] Outline is work consisting of brief statements of the principal elements of a subject, usually arranged by heads and subheads.

name: ozone
query: Query: ozone [SEP] Ozone is the unstable triatomic form of oxygen, o3. It is a powerful oxidant that is produced for various chemical and industrial uses. Its production is also catalyzed in the atmosphere by ultraviolet ray irradiation of oxygen or other ozone precursors such as volatile organic compounds and nitrogen oxides. About 90% of the ozone in the atmosphere exists in the stratosphere (stratospheric ozone).

name: ozone depletion
query: Query: ozone depletion [SEP] Ozone depletion is a shift in the balance between production and destruction of stratospheric ozone that results in a decline of the amount of ozone in the lower stratosphere.

name: pain , procedural
query: Query: pain , procedural [SEP] Procedural pain is pain associated with examination, treatment or procedures.

name: pain , referred
query: Query: pain , referred [SEP] Referred pain is a type of pain that is perceived in an area away from the site where the pain arises, such as facial pain caused by lesion of the vagus nerve, or throat problem generating referred pain in the ear.

name: pain measurement
query: Query: pain measurement [SEP] Pain measurement is scales, questionnaires, tests, and other methods used to assess pain severity and duration in patients or experimental animals to aid in diagnosis, therapy, and physiological studies.

name: palate , hard
query: Query: palate , hard [SEP] Hard palate is the anteriorly located rigid section of the palate.

name: pancreatic cyst
query: Query: pancreatic cyst [SEP] Pancreatic cyst is a true cyst of the pancreas, distinguished from the much more common pancreatic pseudocyst by possessing a lining of mucous epithelium. Pancreatic cysts are categorized as congenital, retention, neoplastic, parasitic, enterogenous, or dermoid. Congenital cysts occur more frequently as solitary cysts but may be multiple. Retention cysts are gross enlargements of pancreatic ducts secondary to ductal obstruction. (From Bockus Gastroenterology, 4th ed, p4145)

name: pancreatitis , acute hemorrhagic
query: Query: pancreatitis , acute hemorrhagic [SEP] Acute hemorrhagic pancreatitis is an acute inflammation of the pancreas in which the initial edematous pancreatitis evolved into necrosis accompanied by hemorrhage.

name: paraffin
query: Query: paraffin [SEP] Paraffin is a mixture of solid hydrocarbons obtained from petroleum. It has a wide range of uses including as a stiffening agent in ointments, as a lubricant, and as a topical anti-inflammatory. It is also commonly used as an embedding material in histology.

name: parasite egg count
query: Query: parasite egg count [SEP] Parasite egg count is determination of parasite eggs in feces.

name: parathyroid glands
query: Query: parathyroid glands [SEP] Parathyroid glands is two pairs of small oval-shaped glands located in the front and the base of the neck and adjacent to the two lobes of thyroid gland. name: parental notification
query: Query: parental notification [SEP] Parental notification is reporting to parents or guardians about care to be provided to a minor (minors).

name: parenteral nutrition solutions
query: Query: parenteral nutrition solutions [SEP] Parenteral nutrition solutions is specialized solutions for parenteral nutrition. They may contain a variety of micronutrients; vitamins; amino acids; carbohydrates; lipids; and salts.

name: parietal cells , gastric
query: Query: parietal cells , gastric [SEP] Gastric parietal cells is rounded or pyramidal cells of the gastric glands. They secrete hydrochloric acid and produce gastric intrinsic factor, a glycoprotein that binds vitamin b12.

name: partial pressure
query: Query: partial pressure [SEP] Partial pressure is the pressure that would be exerted by one component of a mixture of gases if it were present alone in a container. (From McGraw-Hill Dictionary of Scientific and Technical Terms, 6th ed)

name: paternal deprivation
query: Query: paternal deprivation [SEP] Paternal deprivation is prolonged separation of the offspring from the father.

name: paternal inheritance
query: Query: paternal inheritance [SEP] Paternal inheritance is a form of inheritance where the traits of the offspring are paternal in origin due to the expression of extra-nuclear genetic material such as mitochondrial dna or y chromosome genes. centrioles are also paternally inherited.

name: pathology , veterinary
query: Query: pathology , veterinary [SEP] Veterinary pathology is the field of veterinary medicine concerned with the causes of and changes produced in the body by disease.

name: patient freedom of choice laws

name: patient handoff
query: Query: patient handoff [SEP] Patient handoff is the transferring of patient care responsibility from one health-care professional to another.

name: patient reported outcome measures
query: Query: patient reported outcome measures [SEP] Patient reported outcome measures is assessment of the quality and effectiveness of health care as measured and directly reported by the patient.

name: patients ' rooms
query: Query: patients ' rooms [SEP] Patients' rooms is the room occupied by one or more individuals during a stay in a health facility.

name: patient selection
query: Query: patient selection [SEP] Patient selection is criteria and standards used for the determination of the appropriateness of the inclusion of patients with specific conditions in proposed treatment plans and the criteria used for the inclusion of subjects in various clinical trials and other research protocols.

name: patient transfer
query: Query: patient transfer [SEP] Patient transfer is interfacility or intrahospital transfer of patients. Intrahospital transfer is usually to obtain a specific kind of care and interfacility transfer is usually for economic reasons as well as for the type of care provided.

name: pattern recognition , automated
query: Query: pattern recognition , automated [SEP] Automated pattern recognition is in information retrieval, machine-sensing or identification of visible patterns (shapes, forms, and configurations). (Harrod's Librarians' Glossary, 7th ed)

name: pediatric emergency medicine
query: Query: pediatric emergency medicine [SEP] Pediatric emergency medicine is branch of emergency medicine dealing with the emergency care of children.

name: peer review , research
query: Query: peer review , research [SEP] Research peer review is the evaluation by experts of the quality and pertinence of research or research proposals of other experts in the same field. name: pelvic floor

name: pelvic pain

name: peptide library

name: perceptual closure

name: perceptual distortion

name: perceptual masking
query: Query: perceptual masking [SEP] Perceptual masking is the interference of one perceptual stimulus with another causing a decrease or lessening in perceptual effectiveness.

name: performance anxiety
query: Query: performance anxiety [SEP] Performance anxiety is anxiety related to the execution of a task. (Campbell's Psychiatric Dictionary, 9th ed.)

name: periodical index

name: peripheral arterial disease

name: peripheral blood stem cells

name: peritoneal lavage
query: Query: peritoneal lavage [SEP] Peritoneal lavage is washing out of the peritoneal cavity. The procedure is a diagnostic as well as a therapeutic technique following abdominal trauma or inflammation.

name: persistent vegetative state
query: Query: persistent vegetative state [SEP] Persistent vegetative state is vegetative state refers to the neurocognitive status of individuals with severe brain damage, in whom physiologic functions (sleep-wake cycles, autonomic control, and breathing) persist, but awareness (including all cognitive function and emotion) is abolished.

name: personnel selection
query: Query: personnel selection [SEP] Personnel selection is the process of choosing employees for specific types of employment. The concept includes recruitment.

name: pest control , biological

name: phagocytosis

(From Neurol Clin 1998 Nov;16(4):919-36; Brain 1998 Sep;121(Pt 9):1603-30)

name: pharmaceutical vehicles

name: pharmacy research

name: phosphorus acids
query: Query: phosphorus acids [SEP] Phosphorus acids is inorganic acids that contain phosphorus as an integral part of the molecule.

name: photosynthesis

In higher plants; green algae; and cyanobacteria; nadph and atp formed by the light reactions drive the dark reactions which result in the fixation of carbon dioxide. (from Oxford Dictionary of Biochemistry and Molecular Biology, 2001)

name: physician payment review commission

name: pituitary irradiation
query: Query: pituitary irradiation [SEP] Pituitary irradiation is radiation therapy used to treat the pituitary gland.

name: plaque , atherosclerotic

name: plasminogen activator inhibitor 1

name: platinum

name: pneumonia , pneumococcal
query: Query: pneumonia , pneumococcal [SEP] Pneumococcal pneumonia is a febrile disease caused by streptococcus pneumoniae.

name: point mutation

name: police
query: Query: police [SEP] Police is agents of the law charged with the responsibility of maintaining and enforcing law and order among the citizenry.

name: population health management

name: posterior capsule of the lens

name: postoperative nausea and vomiting
query: Query: postoperative nausea and vomiting [SEP] Postoperative nausea and vomiting is emesis and queasiness occurring after anesthesia.

name: postural balance
query: Query: postural balance [SEP] Postural balance is a posture in which an ideal body mass distribution is achieved. Postural balance provides the body carriage stability and conditions for normal functions in stationary position or in movement, such as sitting, standing, or walking.

name: potassium chloride

name: potassium deficiency

Muscular malfunction may result in hypoventilation, paralytic ileus, hypotension, muscle twitches, tetany, and rhabomyolysis. Nephropathy from potassium deficit impairs the concentrating mechanism, producing polyuria and decreased maximal urinary concentrating ability with secondary polydipsia. (Merck Manual, 16th ed)

name: potassium isotopes
query: Query: potassium isotopes [SEP] Potassium isotopes is stable potassium atoms that have the same atomic number as the element potassium, but differ in atomic weight. k-41 is a stable potassium isotope.

name: practice guidelines as topic

The guidelines may be developed by government agencies at any level, institutions, professional societies, governing boards, or by the convening of expert panels. The guidelines form a basis for the evaluation of all aspects of health care and delivery.

name: practice management , veterinary
query: Query: practice management , veterinary [SEP] Veterinary practice management is the organization and operation of the business aspects of a veterinary practice.

name: pregnancy , abdominal
query: Query: pregnancy , abdominal [SEP] Abdominal pregnancy is a type of ectopic pregnancy in which the embryo, mammalian implants in the abdominal cavity instead of in the endometrium of the uterus.

name: pregnancy , triplet
query: Query: pregnancy , triplet [SEP] Triplet pregnancy is the condition of carrying triplets simultaneously.

name: pregnancy , unwanted
query: Query: pregnancy , unwanted [SEP] Unwanted pregnancy is pregnancy, usually accidental, that is not desired by the parent or parents.

name: pregnancy maintenance
query: Query: pregnancy maintenance [SEP] Pregnancy maintenance is physiological mechanisms that sustain the state of pregnancy.

name: prenatal exposure delayed effects
query: Query: prenatal exposure delayed effects [SEP] Prenatal exposure delayed effects is the consequences of exposing the fetus in utero to certain factors, such as nutrition physiological phenomena; physiological stress; drugs; radiation; and other physical or chemical factors. name: prevalence

name: preventive psychiatry
query: Query: preventive psychiatry [SEP] Preventive psychiatry is a discipline concerned with the prevention of mental illness and the promotion of mental health.

name: price list
query: Query: price list [SEP] Price list is work consisting of lists giving the prices of items for sale, including drugs, equipment, books, etc. Price lists are less detailed than catalogs and not as long.

name: primary ovarian insufficiency

The most commonly known genetic cause is the expansion of a cgg repeat to 55 to 199 copies in the 5' untranslated region in the X-linked fmr1 gene.

name: problem behavior
query: Query: problem behavior [SEP] Problem behavior is troublesome or disruptive behavioral displays.

name: process assessment , health care
query: Query: process assessment , health care [SEP] Health care process assessment is an evaluation procedure that focuses on how care is delivered, based on the premise that there are standards of performance for activities undertaken in delivering patient care, in which the specific actions taken, events occurring, and human interactions are compared with accepted standards.

name: program development
query: Query: program development [SEP] Program development is the process of formulating, improving, and expanding educational, managerial, or service-oriented work plans (excluding computer program development).

name: propensity score
query: Query: propensity score [SEP] Propensity score is conditional probability of exposure to a treatment given observed covariates.

name: prophylactic surgical procedures

name: prostatic secretory proteins

name: proton magnetic resonance spectroscopy

name: proton pump inhibitors

name: receptor , fibroblast growth factor , type 4
query: Query: receptor , fibroblast growth factor , type 4 [SEP] Type 4 fibroblast growth factor receptor is a fibroblast growth factor receptor that is mainly expressed in lung; kidney; pancreas; and spleen. name: receptors , albumin
query: Query: receptors , albumin [SEP] Albumin receptors is cell surface proteins that bind albumin with high affinity and trigger intracellular changes influencing the behavior of cells.

Although macrophage-1 antigen is considered an important signaling molecule for fibrinogen interaction, a variety of integrins from all three major families, (beta1, beta2, and beta3) have been shown to bind fibrinogen.

name: receptors , glutamate
query: Query: receptors , glutamate [SEP] Glutamate receptors is cell-surface proteins that bind glutamate and trigger changes which influence the behavior of cells. name: receptors for activated c kinase

name: recognition , psychology

name: refractive errors

name: reinforcement schedule

name: relational autonomy

name: religion and science

name: religion and sex
query: Query: religion and sex [SEP] Religion and sex is the interrelationship of religion and sexual practices and beliefs.

name: renal agents

name: renal artery

name: resource allocation

name: retinal artery

name: retirement

name: retrospective moral judgment

(From Adams et al., Principles of Neurology, 6th ed, p395)

Specific learning disorder may occur in individuals identified as intellectually gifted and manifest only when the learning demands or assessment procedures (e.g., timed tests) pose barriers that cannot be overcome by their innate intelligence and compensatory strategies. For all individuals, specific learning disorder can produce lifelong impairments in activities dependent on the skills, including occupational performance. (from dsm-v)

name: spontaneous perforation

name: sports for persons with disabilities

name: starch

name: starvation

name: stem cell research

name: stomach , avian

name: strategic planning

name: stroke rehabilitation

name: stroke volume

name: student health services

name: study guides as topic

name: supine position

name: suppressor of cytokine signaling 3 protein
query: Query: suppressor of cytokine signaling 3 protein [SEP] Suppressor of cytokine signaling 3 protein is a suppressor of cytokine signaling protein that consists of an N-terminal kinase-inhibitory region, a central sh2 domain, a characteristic C-terminal socs box (a 40-amino acid motif, which functions to recruit e3 ubiquitin-protein ligase complexes). socs3 inhibits cytokine signaling by binding to receptor protein-tyrosine kinases as well as cytokine receptor gp130; erythropoietin receptors; insulin receptor; and the leptin receptor. name: surface tension
query: Query: surface tension [SEP] Surface tension is the force acting on the surface of a liquid, tending to minimize the area of the surface. (From McGraw-Hill Dictionary of Scientific and Technical Terms, 6th ed)

name: surgical wound infection
query: Query: surgical wound infection [SEP] Surgical wound infection is infection occurring at the site of a surgical incision.

name: surrogate mothers
query: Query: surrogate mothers [SEP] Surrogate mothers is women who allow themselves to be impregnated with the understanding that the offspring are to be given over to the parents who have commissioned the surrogate.

name: switzerland
query: Query: switzerland [SEP] Switzerland is a country in Europe. It is bordered by Austria, France, Italy, Liechtenstein, and Germany. The capital is Bern.

name: systematic review

name: tables
query: Query: tables [SEP] Tables is presentations of data in tabular form.

name: tai ji
query: Query: tai ji [SEP] Tai ji is one of the martial arts and also a form of meditative exercise using methodically slow circular stretching movements and positions of body balance.

name: taiwan
query: Query: taiwan [SEP] Taiwan is country in eastern Asia, islands bordering the East China Sea, Philippine Sea, South China Sea, and Taiwan Strait, north of the Philippines, off the southeastern coast of China. The capital is Taipei. The alternate country name is Republic of China.

name: tanzania
query: Query: tanzania [SEP] Tanzania is a republic in eastern Africa, south of uganda and north of mozambique. Its capital is Dar es Salaam. It was formed in 1964 by a merger of the countries of tanganyika and zanzibar.

name: taste perception
query: Query: taste perception [SEP] Taste perception is the process by which the nature and meaning of gustatory stimuli are recognized and interpreted by the brain. The five basic classes of taste perception are salty, sweet, bitter, sour and umami.

name: telomere shortening
query: Query: telomere shortening [SEP] Telomere shortening is the loss of some telomere sequence during dna replication of the first several base pairs of a linear dna molecule; or from dna damage. Cells have various mechanisms to restore length (telomere homeostasis.) Telomere shortening is involved in the progression of cell aging.

name: temporal bone
query: Query: temporal bone [SEP] Temporal bone is either of a pair of compound bones forming the lateral (left and right) surfaces and base of the skull which contains the organs of hearing. It is a large bone formed by the fusion of parts: the squamous (the flattened anterior-superior part), the tympanic (the curved anterior-inferior part), the mastoid (the irregular posterior portion), and the petrous (the part at the base of the skull).

name: tertiary prevention
query: Query: tertiary prevention [SEP] Tertiary prevention is measures aimed at providing appropriate supportive and rehabilitative services to minimize morbidity and maximize quality of life after a long-term disease or injury is present.

name: test anxiety scale
query: Query: test anxiety scale [SEP] Test anxiety scale is a self-reporting test consisting of items concerning fear and worry about taking tests and physiological activity, such as heart rate, sweating, etc., before, during, and after tests.

name: textile industry
query: Query: textile industry [SEP] Textile industry is the aggregate business enterprise of manufacturing textiles. (From Random House Unabridged Dictionary, 2d ed)

name: theory of mind
query: Query: theory of mind [SEP] Theory of mind is the ability to attribute mental states (e.g., beliefs, desires, feelings, intentions, thoughts, etc.) to self and to others, allowing an individual to understand and infer behavior on the basis of the mental states. Difference or deficit in theory of mind is associated with asperger syndrome; autistic disorder; and schizophrenia, etc.

name: therapeutic human experimentation
query: Query: therapeutic human experimentation [SEP] Therapeutic human experimentation is human experimentation that is intended to benefit the subjects on whom it is performed.

name: thermal conductivity
query: Query: thermal conductivity [SEP] Thermal conductivity is the heat flow across a surface per unit area per unit time, divided by the negative of the rate of change of temperature with distance in a direction perpendicular to the surface. (From McGraw-Hill Dictionary of Scientific and Technical Terms, 6th ed)

name: thigh
query: Query: thigh [SEP] Thigh is the superior part of the lower extremity between the hip and the knee.

name: thoracic diseases
query: Query: thoracic diseases [SEP] Thoracic diseases is disorders affecting the organs of the thorax.

name: threshold limit values
query: Query: threshold limit values [SEP] Threshold limit values is standards for limiting worker exposure to airborne contaminants. They are the maximum concentration in air at which it is believed that a particular substance will not produce adverse health effects with repeated daily exposure. It can be a time-weighted average (tlv-twa), a short-term value (tlv-stel), or an instantaneous value (TLV-Ceiling). They are expressed either as parts per million (ppm) or milligram per cubic meter (mg/m3).

name: thrombin time
query: Query: thrombin time [SEP] Thrombin time is clotting time of plasma mixed with a thrombin solution. It is a measure of the conversion of fibrinogen to fibrin, which is prolonged by afibrinogenemia, abnormal fibrinogen, or the presence of inhibitory substances, e.g., fibrin-fibrinogen degradation products, or heparin. batroxobin, a thrombin-like enzyme unaffected by the presence of heparin, may be used in place of thrombin.

name: thymus hyperplasia
query: Query: thymus hyperplasia [SEP] Thymus hyperplasia is enlargement of the thymus. a condition described in the late 1940's and 1950's as pathological thymic hypertrophy was status thymolymphaticus and was treated with radiotherapy. Unnecessary removal of the thymus was also practiced. It later became apparent that the thymus undergoes normal physiological hypertrophy, reaching a maximum at puberty and involuting thereafter. The concept of status thymolymphaticus has been abandoned. Thymus hyperplasia is present in two thirds of all patients with myasthenia gravis. (From Segen, Dictionary of Modern Medicine, 1992; Cecil Textbook of Medicine, 19th ed, p1486)

name: tibial fractures
query: Query: tibial fractures [SEP] Tibial fractures is fractures of the tibia.

name: tidal waves
query: Query: tidal waves [SEP] Tidal waves is water waves caused by the gravitational interactions between the earth; moon; and sun.

name: time perception
query: Query: time perception [SEP] Time perception is the ability to estimate periods of time lapsed or duration of time.

name: tissue polypeptide antigen
query: Query: tissue polypeptide antigen [SEP] Tissue polypeptide antigen is serological tumor marker composed of a molecular complex of cytokeratins 8, 18, and 19. It is used in the diagnosis and staging of bronchogenic carcinoma.

name: titanium
query: Query: titanium [SEP] Titanium is a dark-gray, metallic element of widespread distribution but occurring in small amounts with atomic number, 22, atomic weight, 47.867 and symbol, Ti; specific gravity, 4.5; used for fixation of fractures.

name: tobacco industry

name: tobacco necrosis satellite virus

name: tobacco products

name: toluene
query: Query: toluene [SEP] Toluene is a widely used industrial solvent.

name: tongue neoplasms
query: Query: tongue neoplasms [SEP] Tongue neoplasms is tumors or cancer of the tongue.

name: tooth apex
query: Query: tooth apex [SEP] Tooth apex is the tip or terminal end of the root of a tooth. (Jablonski, Dictionary of Dentistry, 1992, p62)

name: tooth calcification
query: Query: tooth calcification [SEP] Tooth calcification is the process whereby calcium salts are deposited in the dental enamel. The process is normal in the development of bones and teeth. (Boucher's Clinical Dental Terminology, 4th ed, p43)

name: topography , medical
query: Query: topography , medical [SEP] Medical topography is the systematic surveying, mapping, charting, and description of specific geographical sites, with reference to the physical features that were presumed to influence health and disease. Medical topography should be differentiated from epidemiology in that the former emphasizes geography whereas the latter emphasizes disease outbreaks.

name: torque
query: Query: torque [SEP] Torque is the rotational force about an axis that is equal to the product of a force times the distance from the axis where the force is applied.

name: total disc replacement

name: toxicity tests , acute

name: trachea
query: Query: trachea [SEP] Trachea is the cartilaginous and membranous tube descending from the larynx and branching into the right and left main bronchi.

name: traditional pulse diagnosis
query: Query: traditional pulse diagnosis [SEP] Traditional pulse diagnosis is technique used in ayurvedic medicine, and east asian traditional medicine, in which reading pulse is used in the diagnosis of diseases.

name: transcriptional activation

name: transducers , pressure

name: transplants
query: Query: transplants [SEP] Transplants is organs, tissues, or cells taken from the body for grafting into another area of the same body or into another individual.

name: tropical medicine
query: Query: tropical medicine [SEP] Tropical medicine is the branch of medicine concerned with diseases, mainly of parasitic origin, common in tropical and subtropical regions.

name: truth disclosure
query: Query: truth disclosure [SEP] Truth disclosure is truthful revelation of information, specifically when the information disclosed is likely to be psychologically painful ("bad news") to the recipient (e.g., revelation to a patient or a patient's family of the patient's diagnosis or prognosis) or embarrassing to the teller (e.g., revelation of medical errors).

name: trypsin inhibitors
query: Query: trypsin inhibitors [SEP] Trypsin inhibitors is serine proteinase inhibitors which inhibit trypsin. They may be endogenous or exogenous compounds.

name: tuberculosis , bovine
query: Query: tuberculosis , bovine [SEP] Bovine tuberculosis is an infection of cattle caused by mycobacterium bovis. It is transmissible to man and other animals.

name: tuberculosis , female genital
query: Query: tuberculosis , female genital [SEP] Female genital tuberculosis is mycobacterium infections of the female reproductive tract (genitalia, female).

name: tuberculosis , lymph node

name: tuberculosis , pleural
query: Query: tuberculosis , pleural [SEP] Pleural tuberculosis is tuberculosis of the serous membrane lining the thoracic cavity and surrounding the lungs.

name: tuberculosis , renal
query: Query: tuberculosis , renal [SEP] Renal tuberculosis is infection of the kidney with species of mycobacterium.

name: tuberculosis , splenic
query: Query: tuberculosis , splenic [SEP] Splenic tuberculosis is infection of the spleen with species of mycobacterium.

name: tumor escape
query: Query: tumor escape [SEP] Tumor escape is the ability of tumors to evade destruction by the immune system. Theories concerning possible mechanisms by which this takes place involve both cellular immunity (immunity, cellular) and humoral immunity (antibody formation), and also costimulatory pathways related to cd28 antigens and b7-1 antigen.

name: tumor necrosis factor ligand superfamily member 14
query: Query: tumor necrosis factor ligand superfamily member 14 [SEP] Tumor necrosis factor ligand superfamily member 14 is a member of tumor necrosis factor superfamily found on activated lymphocytes and monocytes. It occurs as transmembrane protein that can be cleaved to release a secreted form that specifically binds to lymphotoxin beta receptor and tumor necrosis factor receptor superfamily, member 14.

name: type iv secretion systems
query: Query: type iv secretion systems [SEP] Type iv secretion systems is multiprotein complexes that transport single proteins, multiprotein complexes, and nucleoprotein complexes from the cytoplasm into the extracellular space or into recipient cells. T4SSs are found in gram-negative bacteria, while homologous components to T4SSs are found in gram-postive bacteria.

name: type vii secretion systems
query: Query: type vii secretion systems [SEP] Type vii secretion systems is bacterial secretion systems found in bacteria that have a mycolic ACID-containing outer membrane such as mycobacteriaceae; Corynebacteriaceae; and nocardiaceae. There are several subtypes of T7SSs including esx-1, esx-2, esx-3, esx-4, and esx-5 secretion systems. name: ultrasonic waves
query: Query: ultrasonic waves [SEP] Ultrasonic waves is oscillating sound wave with a frequency higher than the upper limit of the human hearing range.

name: ultrasonography , doppler , pulsed
query: Query: ultrasonography , doppler , pulsed [SEP] Pulsed doppler ultrasonography is ultrasonography applying the Doppler effect, with velocity detection combined with range discrimination. Short bursts of ultrasound are transmitted at regular intervals and the echoes are demodulated as they return.

name: ultrasonography , interventional
query: Query: ultrasonography , interventional [SEP] Interventional ultrasonography is the use of ultrasound to guide minimally invasive surgical procedures such as needle aspiration biopsy; drainage; etc. Its widest application is intravascular ultrasound imaging but it is useful also in urology and intra-abdominal conditions.

name: ultrasonography , mammary
query: Query: ultrasonography , mammary [SEP] Mammary ultrasonography is use of ultrasound for imaging the breast. The most frequent application is the diagnosis of neoplasms of the female breast.

name: uncertainty
query: Query: uncertainty [SEP] Uncertainty is the condition in which reasonable knowledge regarding risks, benefits, or the future is not available.

name: united states agency for healthcare research and quality
query: Query: united states agency for healthcare research and quality [SEP] United states agency for healthcare research and quality is an agency of the public health service established in 1990 to "provide indexing, abstracting, translating, publishing, and other services leading to a more effective and timely dissemination of information on research, demonstration projects, and evaluations with respect to health care to public and private entities and individuals engaged in the improvement of health care delivery..." It supersedes the National Center for Health Services Research. The United States Agency for Health Care Policy and Research was renamed Agency for Healthcare Research and Quality (ahrq) under the Healthcare Research and Quality Act of 1999.

name: united states agency for international development

The goals of the program are to reduce illicit drug use, manufacturing, and trafficking, drug-related crime and violence, and drug-related health consequences.

name: universal design

name: unrelated donors

name: urban health services

name: urinary bladder fistula

name: uterine contraction
query: Query: uterine contraction [SEP] Uterine contraction is contraction of the uterine muscle.

name: uterine inversion

name: vaccination coverage
query: Query: vaccination coverage [SEP] Vaccination coverage is rate of vaccination as defined by geography and or demography.

name: value of life
query: Query: value of life [SEP] Value of life is the intrinsic moral worth ascribed to a living being. (Bioethics Thesaurus)

name: vapor pressure
query: Query: vapor pressure [SEP] Vapor pressure is the contribution to barometric pressure of gaseous substance in equilibrium with its solid or liquid phase.

name: vascular endothelial growth factor c
query: Query: vascular endothelial growth factor c [SEP] Vascular endothelial growth factor c is a vascular endothelial growth factor that specifically binds to vascular endothelial growth factor receptor-2 and vascular endothelial growth factor receptor-3. name: vascular patency
query: Query: vascular patency [SEP] Vascular patency is the degree to which blood vessels are not blocked or obstructed.

name: ventilator weaning

Present methods include intermittent mandatory ventilation, intermittent positive pressure ventilation, and mandatory minute volume ventilation.

name: vertebral artery dissection

Vertebral artery dissection is often associated with trauma and injuries to the head-neck region but can occur spontaneously.

name: veterans health
query: Query: veterans health [SEP] Veterans health is the concept covering the physical and mental conditions of veterans.

name: video games
query: Query: video games [SEP] Video games is a form of interactive entertainment in which the player controls electronically generated images that appear on a video display screen. This includes video games played in the home on special machines or home computers, and those played in arcades.

name: viral fusion proteins
query: Query: viral fusion proteins [SEP] Viral fusion proteins is proteins, usually glycoproteins, found in the viral envelopes of a variety of viruses. They promote cell membrane fusion and thereby may function in the uptake of the virus by cells.

name: viral load
query: Query: viral load [SEP] Viral load is the quantity of measurable virus in a body fluid. Change in viral load, measured in plasma, is sometimes used as a surrogate marker in disease progression.

Clear lysed areas or plaques develop as the viral particles are released from the infected cells during incubation. With some viruses, the cells are killed by a cytopathic effect; with others, the infected cells are not killed but can be detected by their hemadsorptive ability. Sometimes the plaque cells contain viral antigens which can be measured by immunofluorescence.

name: viral regulatory and accessory proteins
query: Query: viral regulatory and accessory proteins [SEP] Viral regulatory and accessory proteins is a broad category of viral proteins that play indirect roles in the biological processes and activities of viruses. query: Query: virus activation [SEP] Virus activation is the mechanism by which latent viruses, such as genetically transmitted tumor viruses (proviruses) or prophages of lysogenic bacteria, are induced to replicate and then released as infectious viruses. name: viscoelastic substances
query: Query: viscoelastic substances [SEP] Viscoelastic substances is substances that display the physical properties of elasticity and viscosity. The dual-nature of these substances causes them to resist applied forces in a time-dependent manner.

name: visible human projects
query: Query: visible human projects [SEP] Visible human projects is digital image data sets, consisting of complete, anatomically detailed, three-dimensional representations of the normal male and female human bodies.

name: vision , binocular
query: Query: vision , binocular [SEP] Binocular vision is the blending of separate images seen by each eye into one composite image.

name: vision screening
query: Query: vision screening [SEP] Vision screening is application of tests and examinations to identify visual defects or vision disorders occurring in specific populations, as in school children, the elderly, etc. It is differentiated from vision tests, which are given to evaluate/measure individual visual performance not related to a specific population.

name: visual fields
query: Query: visual fields [SEP] Visual fields is the total area or space visible in a person's peripheral vision with the eye looking straightforward.

name: vitamin k 1

Vitamin k1 has antihemorrhagic and prothrombogenic activity.

name: vitamin u
query: Query: vitamin u [SEP] Vitamin u is a vitamin found in green vegetables. It is used in the treatment of peptic ulcers, colitis, and gastritis and has an effect on secretory, acid-forming, and enzymatic functions of the intestinal tract.

name: vocal cord dysfunction
query: Query: vocal cord dysfunction [SEP] Vocal cord dysfunction is a disorder characterized by an intermittent abnormal vocal cords movement toward the midline during inspiration or expiration resulting in upper airway obstruction.

name: voice disorders
query: Query: voice disorders [SEP] Voice disorders is pathological processes that affect voice production, usually involving vocal cords and the laryngeal mucosa. Voice disorders can be caused by organic (anatomical), or functional (emotional or psychological) factors leading to dysphonia; aphonia; and defects in voice quality, loudness, and pitch.

name: voice quality
query: Query: voice quality [SEP] Voice quality is that component of speech which gives the primary distinction to a given speaker's voice when pitch and loudness are excluded. It involves both phonatory and resonatory characteristics. Some of the descriptions of voice quality are harshness, breathiness and nasality.

name: voluntary programs
query: Query: voluntary programs [SEP] Voluntary programs is programs in which participation is not required.

name: water deprivation
query: Query: water deprivation [SEP] Water deprivation is the withholding of water in a structured experimental situation.

name: water quality
query: Query: water quality [SEP] Water quality is a rating of a body of water based on measurable physical, chemical, and biological characteristics.

name: web archive
query: Query: web archive [SEP] Web archive is collection of preserved web pages.

name: wedge argument
query: Query: wedge argument [SEP] Wedge argument is an assertion that an action apparently unobjectionable in itself would set in motion a train of events leading ultimately to an undesirable outcome. (From Cambridge Dictionary of Philosophy, 1995)

name: wetlands
query: Query: wetlands [SEP] Wetlands is environments or habitats at the interface between truly terrestrial ecosystems and truly aquatic systems making them different from each yet highly dependent on both. Adaptations to low soil oxygen characterize many wetland species.

name: williams syndrome
query: Query: williams syndrome [SEP] Williams syndrome is a disorder caused by hemizygous microdeletion of about 28 genes on chromosome 7q11.23, including the elastin gene. Clinical manifestations include supravalvular aortic stenosis; mental retardation; elfin facies; impaired visuospatial constructive abilities; and transient hypercalcemia in infancy. The condition affects both sexes, with onset at birth or in early infancy.

name: wind
query: Query: wind [SEP] Wind is the motion of air relative to the earth's surface.

name: wnt proteins
query: Query: wnt proteins [SEP] Wnt proteins is wnt proteins are a large family of secreted glycoproteins that play essential roles in embryonic and fetal development, and tissue maintenance. They bind to frizzled receptors and act as paracrine protein factors to initiate a variety of signal transduction pathways. The canonical Wnt signaling pathway stabilizes the transcriptional coactivator beta catenin.

name: wood
query: Query: wood [SEP] Wood is a product of hard secondary xylem composed of cellulose, hemicellulose, and lignans, that is under the bark of trees and shrubs. It is used in construction and as a source of charcoal and many other products.

name: workflow
query: Query: workflow [SEP] Workflow is description of pattern of recurrent functions or procedures frequently found in organizational processes, such as notification, decision, and action.

name: work performance
query: Query: work performance [SEP] Work performance is measure of how well someone performs given tasks at their place of work.

name: wrist injuries
query: Query: wrist injuries [SEP] Wrist injuries is injuries to the wrist or the wrist joint.

name: x chromosome inactivation
query: Query: x chromosome inactivation [SEP] X chromosome inactivation is a dosage compensation process occurring at an early embryonic stage in mammalian development whereby, at random, one x chromosome of the pair is repressed in the somatic cells of females.

name: xenograft model antitumor assays
query: Query: xenograft model antitumor assays [SEP] Xenograft model antitumor assays is in vivo methods of screening investigative anticancer drugs, biologic response modifiers or radiotherapies. Human tumor tissue or cells are transplanted into mice or rats followed by tumor treatment regimens. a variety of outcomes are monitored to assess antitumor effectiveness.

name: yeast , dried
query: Query: yeast , dried [SEP] Dried yeast is the dry cells of any suitable strain of saccharomyces cerevisiae or candida. It can be obtained as a by-product from the brewing of beer or by growing on media not suitable for beer production. Dried yeast serves as a source of protein and vitamin b complex.

name: zebrafish proteins
query: Query: zebrafish proteins [SEP] Zebrafish proteins is proteins obtained from the zebrafish. Many of the proteins in this species have been the subject of studies involving basic embryological development (embryology).

name: zinc acetate
query: Query: zinc acetate [SEP] Zinc acetate is a salt produced by the reaction of zinc oxide with acetic acid and used as an astringent, styptic, and emetic.

name: zinc sulfate
query: Query: zinc sulfate [SEP] Zinc sulfate is a compound given in the treatment of conditions associated with zinc deficiency such as acrodermatitis enteropathica. Externally, zinc sulfate is used as an astringent in lotions and eye drops. (Reynolds JEF(Ed): Martindale: The Extra Pharmacopoeia (electronic version). Micromedex, Inc, Englewood, co, 1995)
